{{Quote|I can't believe you wouldn't let me keep my Arkanian-diamond goggles. Those were made for field missions!|Tyrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] owned a pair of '''Arkanian-diamond goggles''' that [[Gender/Legends|he]] used for field missions in place of standard-issue [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]]. The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] goggles were one of many luxuries that Tyrak owned, though he was forbidden by the future [[Voidhound]] from bringing them when he was being extracted from his position as a double-agent in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
